segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְאֵלּוּ אֲסוּרוֹת מִלֶּאֱכוֹל בִּתְרוּמָה: הָאוֹמֶרֶת ״טְמֵאָה אֲנִי לָךְ״, וְשֶׁבָּאוּ עֵדִים שֶׁהִיא טְמֵאָה, וְהָאוֹמֶרֶת ״אֵינִי שׁוֹתָה״, וְשֶׁבַּעְלָהּ אֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לְהַשְׁקוֹתָהּ, וְשֶׁבַּעְלָהּ בָּא עָלֶיהָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And these» are women who, despite being married to priests, «are prohibited from partaking of teruma» due to suspicion of adultery: A woman «who says» to her husband: «I am defiled to you,» i.e., she admitted to having committed adultery with another man; «and» in a case «where witnesses came» forth and testified «that she is defiled; and» a woman «who says» after a warning and seclusion: «I will not drink» the bitter water of a sota; «and» in a case «where her husband does not want to force her to drink» the water even after she secluded herself with another man after his warning; «and» in a case «where her husband engaged in sexual intercourse with her on the way» to bringing her to the Temple to drink the bitter water, as in such a case the water will not be effective in evaluating whether she was unfaithful, due to the husband’s own prohibited act.

moves.summary: lists five suspected women barred from teruma

positions.claim: the woman who confesses, against whom witnesses testify, who refuses to drink, whose husband will not have her drink, or with whom he had intercourse on the way, may not eat teruma
